envelope.scope: Nominal 1D force/valve prediction plus measured engineering reserves; not a mathematical upper bound or collision certificate.
envelope.omitted: Full thrust allocation/tracking, horizontal force drift, wind, variable gas mass/pressure, changing support planes and future pilot changes.

headroom.method: Five heading-aligned upward rays along a constant-horizontal-velocity path and the initial support plane; phase-dependent force/valve/geometry height prediction with explicit reserves; bounded to five seconds, 1285 upward rays and 257 support probes.
headroom.notCovered: Continuous swept volume, thin obstacles between samples, horizontal thrust drift, future steering/throttle changes, wind drift or moving obstacles.
